There is a new store and I notice it is missing a few issues.

 

1) Stuff GTG makes is missing. I noticed that the branches and claw expansion of spirit island and the two promo spirits they had listed before the store change are both missing. I wanted to order the promo spirits as a christmas present and was getting on to see if they were back in stock yet.

2) need release dates on stuff not out yet. I will point out all of the Oblivaeon stuff for an example. There is no date yet that says this is in store and actually says will ship in 1-3 days. 3) I didnt check this yet but how well does the new store talk to the old account. Wasnt sure if my preorder for Prime war and all that still show up

Has there been any attempt to look into creating a E and F map for the island as a seperate expansion. Depending on costs I would be willing to buy this over the playmat.

 

If you guys notice anything else in the store that is missing or needs improved please list it here so GTG can take notes on what needs to be fixed.
